summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] shape in the ControlCode union. rich/control.py adds the formatting entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title classmethod, which passes a single two-item tuple to the constructor. rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor and set_alt_screen; it is gated only on is_terminal and returns True after writing the control, False otherwise. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) once per title control, with the wrapper unchanged. CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased, above Fixed, linking PR 2200. Tests were added to tests/test_console.py (test_set_window_title, output assertion skipped on legacy consoles), tests/test_control.py (test_control_title), and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (test_control_set_window_title, Windows-only). Tests and mypy were not run, per instructions; verification was by reading only. Nothing was committed.
